purpose: let the business confirm the delivered solution fits the real need before release
entry_criteria: The release candidate is deployed to an acceptance environment
Acceptance criteria and UAT scenarios are agreed
Business testers and an acceptance owner are named
procedure: Agree the scenarios with the business testers from real work, not only from the specification.
Brief the testers, give them realistic data and a way to report issues.
Run the scenarios and record result, evidence and tester for each.
Triage findings with the product owner into defect, change request or accepted difference.
Retest fixes; track open issues to a decision.
Obtain the acceptance owner's decision: accept, accept with conditions or reject, recorded with the date.
acceptance_criteria: Every scenario has a result and a tester
The acceptance owner's decision is recorded with conditions
Testers are business users, not only the delivery team

validation.check: confirm every UAT scenario row has a result, tester and date
confirm the build tested equals the release candidate

failure_modes.mode: Delivery team acts as business testers
Late change requests treated as defects

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Three finance staff run twelve scenarios on the acceptance environment. Two issues are found; one is a defect, the other a change request deferred. The acceptance owner accepts with the deferral recorded.
